name: Call Minor Monster
body:
School conjuration (calling); Level antipaladin 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, medium 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, spiritualist 3, summoner/unchained summoner 3, witch 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as summon minor monster except it only summons one creature from the list and the creature does not disappear at the end of the spell’s duration. Instead, the creature becomes free-willed and outside the caller’s control. If the creature is destroyed, it does return to its plane as normal.
